description: Combines several PDFs into one, in the order given. 2 files on the Dev plan, up to 20 on paid plans. The result is written next to the first file. The file is uploaded to conv2pdf and the call counts as one conversion.

input_paths.description: Paths of the PDFs on this computer, in the order they must appear in the result.

output_path.description: Where to write the result. Optional: by default next to the input file, under a name that is not taken. An existing file is never overwritten.

name: merge_pdfs
title: Merge PDFs
